name: Flaine
description: Flaine is the most controversial-looking resort in the Alps — designed by Marcel Breuer in the brutalist style, all concrete. Love it or hate it, it works brilliantly as a ski resort: car-free, ski-in/ski-out, excellent snow at 1,600-2,500m. Best value in the Grand Massif (265km). The pedestrian square features a massive sculpture by Jean Dubuffet (Le Boiscour). Good for families, budget skiers, and intermediates.

overview.atmosphere: Controversial brutalist architecture by Marcel Breuer (Bauhaus). Open-air museum with Dubuffet, Picasso, Vasarely. 2,000 m² aquatic centre. Best snow record in the Grand Massif.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Ice driving circuit, big air bag, snow kite, snowmobiling, natural ice rink, bowling, cinema, classical music concerts

honest_drawbacks: Brutalist architecture — strongly disliked by many
